title: O365 DID path built from UPN: public and unstable
description: profiles/o365-employer-did.md §2 derives the did:web path from the UPN: UPN is public in the DID itself (undercuts .20.32 fix) and DID changes on rename, violating spec §2.5.2 'MUST be stable'. Recommended: path from stable opaque ID (Entra object ID or random per-user ID), which also deletes the UPN-change alsoKnownAs flow. Check gsuite and universal-idp profiles for same pattern. Pending Mark's call.
